Definition: from G3420; a remembrance, i.e. cenotaph (place of interment):--grave, sepulchre, tomb.
BiblicalUsage: Mnemeion is a tomb, the burial place — the cave where Lazarus lies four days, the garden tomb where Joseph rolls the stone over Jesus, and the tomb Mary finds empty while it is still dark.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe no word is more hopeful in the Gospels: the tombs keep opening, and the dead keep coming out.
RelatedEvents: Raising of Lazarus; The Burial of Jesus; The Resurrection
